name: Jordan Rivera
default_summary: Backend engineer who ships Python services that stay correct under real-world failure. I design REST APIs, background jobs and data pipelines, and I'm comfortable owning a feature from a vague ticket to a monitored production deploy.

bullets.text: Built and maintain REST APIs (FastAPI) serving the company's shipment-tracking mobile app, including auth, rate limiting and pagination.
Designed a nightly ETL pipeline (Python, Airflow, PostgreSQL) that reconciles carrier data from four external APIs.
Rotate on-call for the shipment-tracking service; triaged and fixed production incidents, including a deadlock in the batch-update job.
Raised integration test coverage on the core shipment service from ~20% to ~70%, catching two regressions before release.
Built an internal usage-analytics dashboard (Django, Chart.js) used by the product team.

projects.name: Package Tracker Side Project
projects.description: Personal project: a Python/FastAPI service that polls three shipping carriers' public APIs and sends SMS updates via Twilio; deployed on a small VPS with Docker.
